verdict.line: You lose if he hits 5 Hemorrhage stacks and dives the all-in; you win if you drag it to items and never trade into his E.

brief.thesis: Darius wins this matchup (48% Garen win rate over 1203 games, lane and solo-kill edge his) because his passive Hemorrhage stacks on every auto and ability hit, and at 5 stacks his next hit carries a true-damage spike that turns an even trade into a kill. Garen has no way to remove those stacks and no gap-closer to punish Darius's Apprehend (E) pull from range, so the fight is always on his terms unless his E is down.

theirWindow.what: Disengage immediately — do not trade through a 5th stack, since his next auto or Q on top of it is the true-damage spike that wins the exchange outright.

yourWindow.what: This is your only safe all-in window. Walk up, force him to auto or Q first so he can't pull you mid-spin, then land E (Judgment) and hold W (Courage) for his response.

powerCurve.note: Q into auto out-trades your kit
E pull punishes any melee engage
Both ults live, all-ins get risky
Full build trades fine if not behind

start.why: Runs 55.2% pick over Doran's Blade's 34.4% in this matchup for a reason — the flat 8 damage block per auto blunts his early poke and the passive HP5 offsets Hemorrhage's tick damage so he can't zone you off farm.

boots.why: 65% pick, 49.1% win rate — the attack speed lets your E (Judgment) tick faster for wave clear and lets you actually punish auto-reset windows instead of needing the pure escape speed of Swiftness.

core.why: The slow proc on your empowered auto is your only tool to prevent him from just walking away after landing his E pull — without it he disengages a lost trade for free.
Attack speed scales your passive Perseverance uptime by ending trades faster, and the slow-resist keeps you in range to punish his cooldowns.
Grievous Wounds shuts down his Q outer-edge heal, which is the main way he sustains through a losing extended trade.

situational.when: he's building health and out-tanking your all-ins
you're ahead and want to force resets before he can stack Hemorrhage back up
you need Grievous Wounds online before three items finish

runes.keystoneWhy: This page runs a 50.9% win rate here versus 47.3% on Conqueror — the burst of speed after your E (Judgment) spin is what actually lets you follow up his retreat or peel off his all-in, which matters more than sustained-fight damage you rarely get to use against his true-damage spike.

summoners.why: 92% pick rate at 48.4% win rate — Ignite's true damage and Grievous Wounds directly answer his Q sustain and give you the extra kill pressure your kit lacks against his true-damage spike.

playing.title: Never fight at 5 stacks
playing.detail: Track your own Hemorrhage stack count on your buff bar all lane — at 4 stacks, back off rather than trade, since the 5th stack's true-damage hit is what flips close trades into deaths.

playing.title: Bait his E before engaging
playing.detail: Apprehend has a real cooldown early (roughly 9 seconds at rank 1). Walk into auto range and watch for the pull animation — if he throws it and misses or you dodge it, that's your window to commit E (Judgment) and W (Courage).

playing.title: Max E, delay Q
playing.detail: Follow the measured order (E first, W second priority, Q last) — the extra spin uptime and cooldown reduction on Judgment matters more here than the Q silence, since you're avoiding extended trades, not initiating them.

playing.title: Hold W for his empowered auto
playing.detail: Courage's damage reduction is strongest timed right as he lands Decimate (Q) or an auto with max Hemorrhage stacks — don't pop it early just to soak chip damage.

playing.title: Freeze, don't shove
playing.detail: Your passive Perseverance only regens when untouched for several seconds — shoving the wave into him invites all-ins where you can't heal between trades, so hold the wave near your tower instead.

playing.title: All-in only above half HP
playing.detail: Demacian Justice (R) does more as a percentage of his missing health, but you need to survive his true-damage window to land it — don't initiate the all-in under 50% HP yourself.

playing.title: Itemize Grievous Wounds on curve
playing.detail: Get Mortal Reminder or Executioner's Calling as soon as he starts winning trades off Q sustain — cutting his outer-edge heal is what turns this from a losing lane into an even one by mid game.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, pick rates, item paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (30,313 Garen games, 1,203 in this matchup); the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade calls are my own coaching read on top of that data, not measured facts.

stats.opponentTip: Bring Ignite when facing Darius to make up for your damage. Avoid being pulled in by his (E) and fight him when his abilities are on cooldown.
